Guild Overview

Mad Cap Warriors was originally created as a no-obligation social posse -- primarily with the idea of collecting together the old guard World 4 players. MCW quickly grew into a convenient network for mature players, new and old, who want to chill and chat while hacking away at virtual vermin.

Latest News

I want to thank and welcome everyone to our little group. When Ting pushed ( :) ) me into this I never thought that we would be so many.

I just wanted to put a few things up here, not really rules or anything but more like expectations. I expect everyone to poke fun at Squeakie every chance they get.....just kiddin'. I personally have very few expectations. I play because I have fun and it relieves stress from my humdrum average everyday life. I expect everyone to have their own reasons for playin and if they sometimes match mine and we can have a blast together then awesome.  :)

We have a solid core of lvl 100's in the group and I know all of them worked very hard to make it to that point. They all have helped me out with things over the past year and I greatly appreciate it. That said they are not anyones personal lvling tool. They sometimes can and will help but never expect it as a given thing.

I have pages of lvl 90+ skittles available to anyone in need. Most of them are not spectacular one but they can be helpful until you find what you are looking for.

Enough of me for now. Will try to get a rooster (?) up sometime soon.

Gary
